name: Radio (nRF24L01)
author: Bench Workshop
description: The nRF24L01+ 2.4 GHz radio module (SPI): two boards send each other small messages (up to 32 bytes) with acknowledgements and retries, as the real chip does. Both need the same channel, data rate and address. Includes RF24.h.

parts.name: Radio (nRF24L01+)
parts.description: VCC 3.3 V (not 5 V!), GND, CE and CSN to any two pins, SCK, MOSI, MISO to the board's SPI pins, IRQ (LOW when something happened) optional. Range here: about 100 m. #include <SPI.h>, <RF24.h>; RF24 radio(CE, CSN); radio.begin(); radio.openWritingPipe(address); radio.write(&data, sizeof(data)); or openReadingPipe(1, address); startListening(); if (radio.available()) radio.read(&data, sizeof(data));

examples.name: Radio remote servo
examples.description: Two boards, two radios. Turn the knob on the left board's bench: it sends the angle 20 times a second; the right board steers its servo to it. Pull a radio's VCC wire off (or drag the boards 2 m apart) and the sender's serial monitor reports lost messages.
